states.name: Alabama

states.regulator_label: Alaska Department of Revenue: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Alaska charitable gaming, including bingo, runs under permits and licenses from the Department of Revenue's Tax Division, 907-465-2581.

states.name: Arizona

states.name: Arkansas

states.regulator_note: Arkansas bingo permits come from the Department of Finance and Administration's Miscellaneous Tax Section, 501-682-7187.

states.name: California

states.regulator_note: For questions about a game or a license, contact the city or county where the game is held.

states.name: Delaware

states.regulator_note: Delaware bingo permits come from the Board of Charitable Gaming at the Division of Professional Regulation, 302-744-4500.

states.regulator_note: DC charitable gaming, including bingo, is licensed by the Office of Lottery and Gaming, 202-645-8000.

states.name: Florida

states.name: Georgia

states.name: Hawaii
states.about: Hawaii does not license bingo. State law treats paying to play a game of chance for a prize as gambling, so there are no bingo halls. We list only free games in Hawaii, such as senior center or community games where nobody pays to play.
states.regulator_label: Hawaii gambling law (Hawaii Revised Statutes 712-1220)
states.regulator_note: No state office licenses bingo in Hawaii.

states.name: Idaho

states.name: Illinois

states.name: Maine

states.regulator_note: For questions about a game or a license, contact the county where it is held. Depending on the county, that may be the sheriff, the county commissioners or a county permits office.

states.name: Massachusetts
